title: Tracker host process
responsibility: Runs approved Tracker host executables with explicit JSON, bounded output, and a scoped process environment.

inputs.name: TrackerHostProcessAdapter.constructor.path
inputs.description: Absolute path to an owner-controlled executable.

inputs.name: TrackerHostProcessAdapter.request.operation
inputs.description: One supported host effect operation passed as a direct argument.

inputs.name: TrackerHostProcessAdapter.request.payload
inputs.description: Operation fields sent as JSON on stdin. The adapter sets the protocol version.

inputs.name: TrackerHostProcessAdapter.request.signal
inputs.description: Lifetime of the command request before drain.

inputs.name: controlledTrackerExecutable.path
inputs.description: Absolute path selected by the node operator.

inputs.name: runTrackerHostCommand.args
inputs.description: Arguments sent directly to the executable without shell evaluation.

inputs.name: runTrackerHostCommand.signal
inputs.description: Signal that terminates the direct host command.

inputs.name: runTrackerHostCommand.options
inputs.type: { input?: string; environment?: Record<string, string>; maxBuffer?: number }
inputs.description: Optional stdin and explicit, command-owned environment variables.

outputs.name: TrackerHostProcessAdapter.request
outputs.description: Run the selected operation and return its versioned JSON response for validation by the caller.

outputs.name: controlledTrackerExecutable
outputs.description: Resolve and validate the executable against the service user and mode requirements.

outputs.name: runTrackerHostCommand
outputs.type: Promise<{ stdout: string; stderr: string; code: number }>
outputs.description: Run the checked executable with bounded output, deadline, and a scoped environment.

errors.name: TrackerHostProcessError
errors.description: The bounded host command could not produce a trustworthy response.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: The configured executable is outside the accepted ownership or permission boundary.
